voltage_input_status: Adopted scales from Tamura et al. (2024): PA bench ~2.2 nV/sqrt(Hz) with 50 ohm termination; integrated EM ~3; requirement 5. These are different reference cases, not a posterior range or flight calibration.
current_input_status: Explicit illustrative current-noise bracket. The published low-impedance voltage bench does not determine this spectrum with the actual coupled antenna load.
correlation_input_status: Assumed independent input sources; the library also supports an explicit positive-semidefinite joint voltage/current PSD.
thermal_input_status: Illustrative nightside temperatures for Moon and antenna-loss emission. Receiver load impedances do not implicitly add amplifier or resistor noise.
reference_plane: One-sided loaded receiver-input voltage spectral covariance in V2/Hz. Voltage source is additive at the measurement plane; current sources enter the full parallel antenna/load network.
frequency_model: Constant input ASDs within each narrow band, with loading frozen at the native band center. Actual chromatic I-only sky power remains frequency dependent.
legacy_spice_status: LUSEE_DRIVE_DIR is unset; the Model54 noise and gain files are unavailable. The legacy Throughput model is not instantiated.
scope: Conditional receiver-noise examples with measured EM voltage scales and assumed current noise/correlations/temperatures; no flight-noise precision claim.
